evidence.note: Claim: a family-profile MCP agent cannot reopen/retag a bug through ddflow_bug because the bug family offers no reopen/tag action (only fixed/invalid/found/file_tasks/dedupe), even though the union schema advertises the reopen/tag parameters. Probe: FS.route('ddflow_bug', {'action':'reopen','id':'Bx','reason':'x'}) returned "ddflow_bug: unknown action 'reopen'. Actions: fixed, invalid, found, file_tasks, dedupe"; the union keys included reason,reopen,tag. CONFIRMED: after adding pinned selector actions the same call routes to ddflow_bug_invalid with reopen=True and the enum lists reopen/tag.

Followed r-gemini-key-load (load GEMINI_API_KEY before review) and checked family_schema/families machinery against the existing D-mcp-tool-families tests; the fix adds no new flat tool (core budget unchanged at 40,541 bytes).

Wrote regression tests first (tests/test_mcp_families.py::test_action_reopen_routes_to_bug_invalid_with_the_selector_set and test_action_tag_routes_to_bug_fixed_with_the_selector_set failed pre-fix with 'unknown action reopen/tag'), then added Family.pinned selector actions (bug reopen->ddflow_bug_invalid reopen=true, tag->ddflow_bug_fixed tag=true), extended family_schema route/enum/description, and regenerated the README tool table. 91 related surface tests pass; test_mcp_parity (151) and test_mcp_tool_budget (5) pass.

roborev job 4368 (reviewer elmdeepseekpro/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813-Godzila) reviewed the combined diff. One LOW note: families.py:64-70 _PINNED re-states the via=(tool, selector) mapping already on bug reopen/bug tag (records.py:507,524). Disposition: refuted as a defect -- the via second element is not uniformly a boolean mode (ddflow_list viewers use the same via shape for kind VALUES such as session/task/search), so _PINNED cannot be derived mechanically without the boolean-mode predicate it already states once; families.py is decoupled from the CLI command declarations (it reads only the tool table), so _PINNED is the frozen placement table, sibling of _LEGACY. No behavioural defect; the added routing tests pin the route() selector injection.
